model: dS = (r-q) S dt + sqrt(v) S dW1, dv = kappa (theta - v) dt + xi sqrt(v) dW2, d<W1,W2> = rho dt
units: prices and Greeks per unit strike (K = 1, S = moneyness S/K); time in years; vega and volga are d/dv0 and d2/dv0^2

development_sample.sampling: independent uniform draws in each coordinate, call or put with probability 1/2; the short split draws tau from tau_short and everything else from ranges
